text: Hello! Ready for today? It's Friday, November 13. Time for the weather! It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! Here in Shanghai, the day will be damp with light drizzle. The high will be 20 degrees, and the low will be 15 degrees. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. Rain is about 88 percent likely today. The sun goes down at 4:56 this evening, about 1 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Pack your umbrella and your wellies! As for tomorrow, expect it to be showery, with a high of 19 degrees. Have you thought any more about warm drinks? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
